exposure: type of delivery (Cesarean section vs. vaginal birth)
antibiotic use and frequency in infancy
cohort: The study included 100 adult patients with stenosis in at least one epicardial vessel and 100 adult controls with normal coronaries, all of whom underwent coronary angiography.
finding: Cesarean section was identified as a significant predictor of premature atherosclerosis, alongside diabetes mellitus and smoking, while breast milk intake and duration was significantly higher in the control group.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was significantly more common in the atherosclerosis group (26%) compared to the control group (3%) (p<0.001) and was an independent predictor of atherosclerosis in multivariate logistic regression analysis (p=0.003).
